content:
Alex: kicking off the FinCore POC sync — they want contract summarization + ingest/search + a secure toolcall for customer-data lookups.
Maria: quick context: customer has HIPAA-ish data, prefers VPC/private deploy, asking about encryption at rest and HSM/KMS support.
Lina: for model fit I recommend testing a 32k-context model for doc-level summaries + an embeddings + reranker flow for retrieval. we should try a quantized 32k candidate and a smaller 8k for fallbacks.
Mike: notes on tool calling: we can surface an internal DB lookup as a tool (signed requests). need to confirm auth pattern and whether they want a sync or async call.
Priya: security checklist items they flagged: SOC2, ISMS, KMS integration, telemetry disabled option, retention controls, and a few specific SSO + audit log questions. I'll send the questionnaire to them today.
Alex: timeline ask from customer: 6-week POC, milestone at week 3 for model selection & eval results, week 6 demo + go/no-go. Is that realistic?
Lina: yes if we scope evals narrowly. propose 3 eval tracks: 1) semantic recall on contract clauses (embeddings + rerank), 2) end-to-end summary quality on 10 canonical contracts (ROUGE/QA), 3) toolcall correctness + latency.
Maria: acceptance criteria suggestion: embeddings recall@10 >= 0.8 on clause retrieval, summary QA pass rate >= 85% on key facts, avg toolcall latency 95th < 350ms.
Mike: infra constraints: private deployment will add 1 week for networking + KMS setup. Dedicated capacity pricing applies if they want predictable throughput.
Alex: pricing question from FinCore: roughly how to compare hosted vs dedicated vs private for a 500k token/month baseline?
Mike: short answer: hosted simplest (usage-based), dedicated = committed monthly cost with lower per-token at scale, private adds license + infra ops. I'll attach ballpark numbers after we confirm batch sizes and caching.
Lina: evaluation plan snippet (we'll send as a prompt set):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the obligations of Party A in section 4 in <= 3 bullets. If none, reply 'no obligations'."
Reference docs: 10 contracts redacted
Metric: exact-fact precision + human QA
```
Maria: security followups: can we support HSM-backed key wrapping for embeddings store? also need to confirm no customer data leaves VPC in private mode.
Priya: yes on HSM for private; for hosted we can offer customer-managed keys via KMS integration (details in SOC2 pack). will confirm telemetry opt-out options.
Alex: next steps: 1) Priya sends questionnaire answers + SOC2 doc by EOD tomorrow. 2) Lina will draft eval prompt set and two model candidates by Tue. 3) Mike to give preliminary cost comps and infra delta. 4) Alex to set customer kickoff Wed 10am PT.
Lina: models I'm proposing for bench: "Mistral-32k" (dense 32k), "Redwood-32k-q4" (quantized), and "Llama-8k-fallback". we'll test generation quality + KV cache behavior.
Mike: reminder for the team: enable prefix caching in the POC config so we can show cost improvements for repeated contract queries.
Alex: blocker from customer: legal asked if we can white-label logs for audit — they don't want raw texts in our platform logs. Priya, is that covered?
Priya: we can mask payloads and send only hashed identifiers to our telemetry. for private deploy full control remains with them. I'll add that to the answer doc.
Maria: one more ask: can we demo rerank vs plain BM25? customer expects a clear uplift chart. Lina — can you prepare a small A/B with precision@5?
Lina: yep, I'll run embeddings+annoy + our reranker and produce precision@5, recall@20, and latency numbers.
Alex: thanks team. I'll confirm the Wed kickoff with FinCore and share calendar invite after Mike posts the cost sheet. :thumbsup:
OnCallBot: Meeting created: FinCore POC Kickoff — Wed 10:00 PT (Zoom link sent).
